CFML Language Reference: Functions

Rand

Returns a pseudo-random decimal number greater than or equal to 0 and less than 1.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Rand()

Returns

A number from 0 up to (but not including) 1.

Usage

The generator is seeded automatically the first time it is used, so each request gets a different sequence. Call Randomize with a fixed seed if you need a repeatable sequence. For a random whole number in a range, RandRange is simpler than Int(Rand() * n) + 1.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<P>Five random numbers (reload for new ones):
<UL>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="5">
<CFOUTPUT><LI>#Rand()#</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</UL>
<CFSET Coin = IIf(Rand() LT 0.5, DE("Heads"), DE("Tails"))>
<CFOUTPUT><P>Coin toss: <B>#Coin#</B></CFOUTPUT>

See also

Randomize, RandRange
